_doc: A lock is a visual fact that may not drift between shots or between films. A render that departs from a lock is rejected by lib/consistency.js, not by the eye. Skin albedo is locked specifically so that no global grade move can lighten a face.

locks.rule: Never lighten. A grade move that raises lab_L beyond tolerance is a defect, not a look.
Never lighten. This is a design lock and carries NO claim about a source-mandated complexion - see entities.json RAMA.complexion_claim.
Post-and-lintel only. An arch or a dome in frame is a rejection.
Cloth is woven, cut from the loom and draped. Anything that reads as sewn is a rejection.

value.position: king's right hand side, on the plinth

locks.rule: Declared staging (see CLM.BALA.20.S.LAMP-HELD). Held for the whole film. It does not move.
